main.description: A wrapped Circle content key, authored by a member into their own permissioned repo. Each record carries one key version sealed to every current recipient.

circleId.description: Stable Circle identity this key belongs to.

keyVersion.description: Monotonic content-key version within the Circle. Posts name the version they were encrypted under.

sender.description: The enrolled sender that sealed this key, authenticated by its mailbox auth key.

recipients.description: One sealed copy of the content key per recipient, sender included. At most 512 so the record stays under the 1 MB write cap.

reason.description: Why this key version was minted.
